Report a bug

Describe the problem and attach the diagnostics .tar.gz from the run that failed. We’ll check the archive, save the report on Quadra’s server, and send the description, log and file to our Discord report channel.

Go to the form

How to get the diagnostics .tar.gz

  1. Open Quadra’s settings. Go to Settings → Environment → Diagnostics.
  2. Turn on both switches: Crash diagnostics and Allow freeze diagnostics. Do this before starting Roblox; the archive check below requires both to be enabled.
  3. Restart Roblox through Quadra. Fully close the old game, start a new run, and repeat the action that causes the problem. Write down what you clicked or pressed and the error you saw.
  4. Return to the Quadra launcher. Open its menu and choose Collect diagnostics. For a crash, collect after it happens. For a freeze, leave Roblox frozen while you collect.
  5. Click Open folder in the Diagnostics collected dialog. Find the newly created quadra-diagnostics-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.tar.gz. Keep this file compressed.
  6. Select that file below. Use the archive from this failed run. The form checks its contents, reads your Quadra version, and verifies both diagnostics settings. If either is off, repeat the steps with both switches enabled.

For a setup or download failure, enable the switches and collect after the error; you can report it even if Roblox never started. Include the failing download URL if the error shows one. If you need help, ask on Discord.
